content: परिग्रहः .²1 Seizing, holding, taking, grasping; आसनरज्जुपरिग्रहे <ls>R. 9. 46</ls>; शङ्कापरिग्रहः <ls>Mu. 1</ls> ‘taking or entertaining a doubt’. .²2 Surrounding, enclosing, encircling, fencing round. .²3 Putting on, wrapping round (as a dress); मौलिपरिग्रहः <ls>R. 18. 38</ls>. .²4 Assuming, taking; मानपरिग्रहः <ls>Amaru. 97</ls>; विवाहलक्ष्मी˚ <ls>U. 4</ls>. .²5 Receiving, taking, accepting, acceptance; भौमो मुनेः स्थानपरिग्रहोऽयम् <ls>R. 13. 36</ls>; अर्घ्यपरिग्रहान्ते <ls n="R. 13.">70</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 16</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 53</ls>; विद्यापरिग्रहाय <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; so आसनपरिग्रहं करोतु देवः <ls>U. 3</ls> ‘your majesty will be pleased to take a seat or sit down’. .²6 Possessions, property, belongings; त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः <ls>Bg. 4. 21</ls>; <ls>R. 15. 55</ls>; <ls>V. 4. 26</ls>. .²7 Taking in marriage, marriage; नवे दारपरिग्रहे <ls>U. 1. 19</ls>; <ls>Māl. 5. 27</ls>; असंशयं क्षत्रपरिग्रहक्षमा <ls>Ś. 1. 22</ls>; न हि गणयति क्षुद्रो जन्तुः परिग्रहफल्गुताम् <ls>Bh. 1. 9</ls>. .²8 A wife, queen; प्रयतपरिग्रहद्वितीयः <ls>R. 1. 95</ls>, <ls n="R. 1.">92</ls>, <ls n="R.">9. 14</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 33</ls>, <ls n="R.">16. 8</ls>; <ls>Ś. 5. 28</ls>, <ls n="Ś. 5.">31</ls>; परिग्रहबहुत्वेऽपि <ls>Ś. 3. 19</ls>; प्राप श्रियं मुनिवरस्य परिग्रहोऽसौ <ls>Rām. Ch.</ls> .²9 Taking under oneʼs protection, favouring; धन्याः स्मो वः परिग्रहात् <ls>U. 7. 11</ls>; <ls>M. 1. 13</ls>; कुर्वन्ति पाण्डवपरिग्रहमेव पौराः <ls>Pañch. 1. 20</ls>. .²10 Attendants, followers, train, retinue, suite; परिग्रहेण सर्वेण कोषेण च महीयसा <ls>Śiva B. 8. 40</ls>. .²11 A household, family, members of a family. .²12 The seraglio or household of a king, harem. .²13 Anything received, a present; राजपरिग्रहोऽयम् <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. .²14 Assent, consent. .²15 Taking possession of, acquiring. .²16 A claim. .²17 Entertaining, honouring, receiving (a guest <ab>&c.</ab>). <ls>Mb. 1. 195. 1</ls>. .²18 An entertainer. .²19 Assistance. .²20 A husband. .²21 Respect, reverence. .²22 Grace, favour. .²23 Comprehension, understanding. .²24 Undertaking, performing. .²25 Subjugation; धर्षितो मत्परिग्रहः <ls>Mb. 12. 320. 55</ls>. .²26 Dominion. .²27 Punishment. .²28 Connection, relation. .²29 Summing up, totality. .²30 A house, residence. .²31 Removing, taking away. .²32 A curse; निर्मुक्तनिष्ठुरपरिग्रहपाशबन्धः <ls>Rām. Ch.</ls> (<ab>cf.</ab> पत्नीपरिजनादानमूलशापाः परिग्रहाः <ls>Ak.</ls>). .²33 (In <ab>Ved.</ab> <ab>gram.</ab>) The double mention of a word both before and after इति. .²34 The form which precedes इति. .²35 Root, origin. .²36 The eclipse of the sun or moon. .²37 An oath. .²38 The rear of an army. .²39 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²40 The body; आश्रयन्त्याः स्वभावेन मम पूर्वपरिग्रहम् <ls>Mb. 12. 320. 57</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> स्वभावेन चित्तेन मम परिग्रहं शरीरम् आश्रयन्त्याः). .²41 Administration; राज्यपरिग्रहः <ls>Mb. 12. 320. 51</ls>.
